content: WRC 2022 official rules and current WRC 2025 index, cross-checked with EMA 2025: riichi requires a closed tenpai hand, a sideways discard and 1,000-point deposit; the hand is locked to tsumogiri except legal ankan; missed ron creates temporary furiten, permanent for the hand after riichi; ippatsu ends on any group call or kan; ura-dora is available only to a riichi winner.
